category_title: Non-symbolic communicators with quadriplegic cerebral palsy who use facial expressions and physical resistance to express preferences
minimal_context: Mary is supporting Tony's head and attempting to feed him with a spoon during mealtime.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for your meal, Tony. I am going to move to support your head now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Tony becomes tense at being handled. His eyes close, his tongue protrudes, and he looks nervous.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just get you set up. Here we go.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Tony remains tense, keeping his eyes closed and looking nervous as his head is supported.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, I am going to try to feed you with this spoon now. Here comes the food.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Tony pushes his tongue out and forces the spoon away from his mouth.)
